name: Displays
summary: Screens of every kind: LCD panels, small character displays, OLEDs, e-ink and old CRTs.
uses: Monitor for a CCTV camera, computer or Raspberry Pi
Small readouts for chargers and meters
LED backlight panels as soft light sources
identify: TVs, monitors, laptops, phones, car stereos and appliance panels; small 16x2 character LCDs sit on printers, alarm panels and lab gear. Older LCDs use thin backlight tubes that hold mercury, and CRTs (deep glass tubes) hold vacuum and charge: leave them whole.
test: Power the whole device and check the picture before stripping it. Shine a torch on a dark LCD: a faint image means the panel works and only the backlight is dead.

decay.note: Lasts dry; cracked panels can’t be fixed.
